notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31778483/b45af44a555ba9907d8c79e2532c6fcf6d87e49a.png

WHAT'S NEW:

 Separate progress in Multiplayer and Campaign modes 
    (so you can upgrade and unlock weapons without multiplayer game)
 Fix map boundaries in some tracks
 Tune weapon drop chances
 Lowered price for some weapons

Some of these changes just went live, so restart your Steam client to make sure you got the update.

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE NEXT UPDATE:

 Audio settings
 Full input rebinding (both keyboard and controller)


What else would you guys love to see implemented soon?
Let us know here in a comment!
-Overlanders Team

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31778483/60ae83541f6cdaf5a3d054e38d1863df4f37a8e3.png

We have already released a few hotfixes in the background. 
In this post, we want to tell you what changed since release and what can you expect in the upcoming days.

Some of these changes just went live, so restart your Steam client to make sure you got the update.

WHAT'S NEW:

 Tuned weapon rates and their strengths
 Switched to a new controller layout as requested by our players
 Improved the difficulty curve of the AI
 Added more settings to customize in the options (still more to come)

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE UPCOMING WEEK:

 Separate progress in Multiplayer and Campaign modes 
(so you can upgrade and unlock weapons without a single multiplayer game)
 Fix map boundaries in some tracks
 Audio settings
 Tune weapon drop chances
 Input rebinding (both keyboard and controller)


What else would you guys love to see implemented soon?
Let us know here in a comment!
-Overlanders Team
